title: pothos englerianus
intro: Pothos englerianus, commonly known as the 'Golden Pothos', is a species of flowering plant in the family Arumaceae. It is an ornamental houseplant that is known for its heart-shaped leaves with variegated patterns in shades of golden green and dark green. The Pothos englerianus plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anxiolytic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is required to fully understand the plant's medicinal potential.
